rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_DNS {
    meta:
        description = "Detects dynamic DNS patterns used by Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        tlp = "amber"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"
    strings:
        $s1 = /\\w{8}\\.execute-api\\.\\w+\\.amazonaws\\.com/ nocase
        $s2 = /\\w{16}\\.cloudfront\\.net/ nocase
        $s3 = /\\w+\\.attacker-domain\\.com/ nocase
    condition:
        any of them
}
